$Comment: What Sawyer Marn pays for a Standing Order. The daily's whole payout is this one table, so
retune the daily here and the quest file never changes.
ROLLS EVALUATE INDEPENDENTLY. Every roll whose Chance passes pays out on the same claim, so a
good day hands over several at once. The first roll always pays, and each one after it is a
bonus on top.
Chance is a percentage, 0 to 100: the chance that roll fires at all; a roll with no Chance
always fires. Count and CountMax together are a range, rolled per grant.
THE FIRST ROLL IS A LADDER, which is what makes the daily grow with the woodcutter instead of
paying a beginner and a veteran the same handful. Its Factors are summed into one score and the
Floors are read against that score; floors are NOT cumulative, so the highest one reached wins
and only its Grants fire. Two things feed the score, weighted equally: the Woodcutting level, so
the order pays better as the skill grows, and Woodcutting luck, so a luck-heavy skill tree pays
here as well as at the bench. Each floor pays Woodcutting XP through a Rewards entry (the
Mmo_Xp kind: Skill plus Amount) and a little tree sap on the side.
UNITS, the one trap worth knowing. Both channels are read as WHOLE NUMBERS: MMO_Luck_WOODCUTTING
stores whole percent points, so a fully claimed Woodcutting tree reads near a hundred rather
than near one, and MMO_Level_WOODCUTTING is a level, not a fraction. The floors below are
therefore written on a scale of roughly 0 to 250, the ceiling a capped level with a full tree
and the trophy hatchet in hand can reach. Never swap these two leaves for the
mmoskilltree:station_luck aggregate: that one returns a FRACTION, which would shift every floor
by a factor of a hundred, and composing it beside a luck channel counts the same investment
twice.
The three chance rolls carry a Cue, the celebration id a roll may author beside its Grants. It
fires only when the grants beside it genuinely paid out. Rare_Find is the everyday chime the
MMO jar ships as a toast; the concentrated essence names the Sawmill's own deep-find cue so a
rare day sounds like a rare cycle. Author a new Cue value plus a
Server/ZiggfreedCommon/FeedbackMoments file of that name for a celebration of your own.
All the odds and floors here are opening balance. Retune them and the daily changes with no
other edit.
Name: Mmo_Sawmill_Order

Rolls.$Comment: Always pays, and pays more the further along the woodcutter is. Floor 0 is what somebody who has only just earned a mill receives; the top floor wants a high level and a full luck tree together rather than one alone.

Floors.$Comment: The starting tier, reachable by anybody, since a score of 0 always passes.
A woodcutter past the early levels, or one who has claimed a few luck rewards.
A committed woodcutter: a solid level with real luck investment behind it.
The top of the ladder, needing both halves near their ceiling rather than one alone.

Rolls.$Comment: The everyday bonus, roughly two days in five: a handful of life essence, the thing the mill pays a lucky woodcutter on top of the planks.
The uncommon bonus, roughly one day in ten: a personal Woodcutting boost token.
The rare pull, roughly one day in thirty-three: one concentrated essence, announced with the Sawmill's own deep-find cue.
